test_GTestHelpTest: test the GTestHelpTest class that verifies --help flag behavior of Google C++ Testing Framework
test_RunWithFlag: test the RunWithFlag function that runs gtest_help_test_ with a given flag and returns exit code and output
test_testPrintsHelpWithFullFlag: test the testPrintsHelpWithFullFlag method that verifies --help prints the help message
test_testPrintsHelpWithShortFlag: test the testPrintsHelpWithShortFlag method that verifies -h prints the help message
test_testPrintsHelpWithIncorrectFlagStyl: test the testPrintsHelpWithIncorrectFlagStyle method that verifies incorrect flag styles print help
